authority: CONTEXT_ONLY: no engine and no decision reads this file
notes: Context only: these numbers inform; none of them is a trade signal unless the evidence engine confirms it (docs/v9/HANDOVER.md, phase D).
A missing value is missing because its source did not answer, never zero.

funding.extremes_rule: coins trading at least $5M a day, above (highest) or below (lowest) the median

premiums.basis: BTC: Coinbase BTC/USD and Upbit BTC/KRW (converted with open.er-api USD/KRW) vs Binance BTC/USDT

units.funding_8h: funding rate per 8 hours (Hyperliquid's hourly rate x 8; Binance and Bybit from Hyperliquid's predicted-funding feed, scaled from their own interval)
units.lsr_taker_24h: taker buy volume / taker sell volume on Gate over 24h
